facts.fact: The Congo's AI strategy technical committee, launched on 6 May 2026 with UNDP technical and financial support, is to produce a structured digital corpus for Lingala and Kituba within its six-month mandate, with a budget of 150 to 200 million FCFA sought, as reported by Les Depeches de Brazzaville.

systems.owner: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, with UNDP
